description: Source code for project management module in OpenERP/Odoo, defining classes and methods for projects, tasks, task types, work logs, and configuration.

classes.name: project
classes.description: Model representing projects with hierarchy, progress, and task management.

classes.name: project_task_type
classes.description: Model for categorizing task types within projects.

classes.name: task
classes.description: Model for individual tasks within projects, including status, hours, and hierarchy.

classes.name: project_work
classes.description: Model for logging work hours on tasks.

classes.name: config_compute_remaining
classes.description: Wizard for recalculating remaining hours on tasks.

methods.name: _complete_name
methods.description: Computes the full hierarchical name of a project.

methods.name: check_recursion
methods.description: Checks for recursive project hierarchy to prevent cycles.

methods.name: onchange_partner_id
methods.description: Updates contact and pricelist info when partner is changed.

methods.name: _progress_rate
methods.description: Calculates project progress metrics based on tasks.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Prevents deletion of projects with existing tasks.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Duplicates a project, including its tasks.

methods.name: duplicate_template
methods.description: Creates a copy of a project template.

methods.name: setActive
methods.description: Activates or deactivates a project and its subprojects and tasks.

methods.name: _name
methods.description: Defines the name of the project.
